_comment: Paths INSIDE the Modal container. The Active8 run and gate-zero decision must be the pair whose source_index_sha256 agree, or open_process_v2_t1_source refuses. Training reads collated rows from packed_store, never RDKit collation.
_gate_zero_note: v6 is the decision whose source_index_sha256 matches the Active8 stream ON THE VOLUME. The locally generated v7 matches the LOCAL Active8 copy, which differs -- the corpus was compiled on Modal, so the volume's Active8 is authoritative here.
_corpus_roots_note: One gzipped JSON-lines object instead of 4,764 slice files. Verified to load identically: same 151,059 entries in the same order, zero differing fields, same 19 exclusions. Per-object latency on a network volume made the slice walk the longest part of container startup.
